question: What is the main job of a computer?

options.B: Storing physical medical record paper files
options.C: Manipulating raw data into useful information
options.D: Replacing the need for human clinical judgment

explanation: You've got this! A computer takes raw inputs (like numbers or typed notes) and turns them into clear, usable information that helps us care for patients better. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h1)

question: Why can't a computer be considered an independent thinker?

options.A: It lacks an internal power source to sustain thought
options.B: It can only process text and never numbers
options.C: It only follows programmed instructions given by humans
options.D: It operates entirely using mechanical gears instead of electricity

explanation: Spot on! Computers are brilliant tools, but they don't have feelings or original thoughts—they simply follow the exact steps humans program them to do. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h1)

question: Which of these is a good example of computer hardware?

options.A: The electronic health record operating program
options.B: The computer monitor on the nurses' station desk
options.D: A typing tutor application used for training

explanation: Great job! Hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer that you can actually touch, like a monitor, keyboard, or mouse. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h2)

question: What happens if a computer has hardware but no software installed?

options.A: It will run at maximum processing speed
options.B: The machine cannot execute any useful tasks
options.C: The physical components will instantly melt down
options.D: It can still process basic patient data offline

explanation: Exactly right! Think of hardware as the body and software as the brain's instructions. Without software, the physical computer just sits there and can't do anything useful. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h2)

question: What is always the very first step in the computer information processing cycle?
explanation: You nailed it! Data has to enter the system first (input) before the computer can process, save, or show it. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h3)

question: A nurse uses a bedside terminal to scan a patient's wristband barcode. What stage of the processing cycle is this?
explanation: Well done! Scanning a barcode feeds fresh data into the computer system, which is a classic example of an input action. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h3)

question: Which type of computer is built specifically for one person to use at a time?
explanation: Spot on! Laptops, desktops, and tablets are all microcomputers—designed for individual, everyday use. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h4)

question: Which computer category is powerful enough to manage a massive national health database?
explanation: You got it! Mainframe computers are heavy-duty systems built to handle massive amounts of data for entire hospitals or health networks. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h4)

question: What is a major clinical benefit of using computers during medication administration?

options.A: Speeding up the manual intravenous injection rate
options.B: Eliminating the need for physical nursing assessments
options.C: Replacing pharmacists in hospital drug dispensing
options.D: Reducing medication errors through barcode scanning

explanation: Excellent! Technology helps keep patients safe by double-checking the right patient, medication, and dose right at the bedside. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h5)

question: Why is computer literacy so important for modern clinical nurses?

options.A: Manual vital sign measurement has been completely banned
options.B: Documentation and patient tracking rely heavily on digital systems
options.C: Hospitals no longer permit handwritten notes under any circumstance
options.D: Nurses are required to write their own hospital software programs

explanation: You nailed it! Electronic health records are everywhere in modern healthcare, so knowing your way around a computer is an essential nursing skill today. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T5#GNS113_U1_T5_h5)
